payload.message: Run skills/discord-signal-brief/SKILL.md across state/config.json channels. If setup is incomplete or the browser/archive source is offline, do not advance cursors and return NO_REPLY unless an urgent setup error needs attention. If shouldNotify is false across all channels, commit noise-only cursors and return NO_REPLY. Otherwise write the report to reports/ and deliver a concise summary putting personal/project mentions first.
